On the other hand, quite a few say they feel lonely because they have fewer chances to see colleagues. Some also find it hard to separate work from home life and end up working even longer hours. At one company, after staff held repeated discussions over these problems, they decided to set aside one day a week for coming into the office. The person in charge says, 'Neither working from home nor coming in is the only right answer. What matters is being able to choose according to the work.'

text_en: Food that is thrown away even though it can still be eaten is called 'food loss'. In Japan, an enormous amount of food is thrown away every year. The causes lie not only with shops but also with households, because people often buy more than they need or leave food in the fridge until it is past its date. In response, more shops have recently started selling items close to their date at lower prices. There are also activities that collect surplus food and deliver it to people who need it. If each of us makes a point of buying only what we need, food loss can surely be reduced.

The volunteer teacher never laughed at my mistakes and patiently explained things as many times as I needed. While going to the class I made friends and started taking part in town events.
